name: floor
notes: Origin maps to U=-152,V=-12. Slots are cut through. Rod tracks: U-136..-62,V138..142; U-2..2,V229..383. Four dia8 table-anchor access holes outside paper. See ASSEMBLY.md.

name: pad_width
notes: Paper face: 90 degree countersink to received M2 head, flush 0..0.05 below surface. Hole Z=18 in assembly.

name: back_width
notes: Ream shaft bores 3.10+.03/-0. N-22..-18. Width plain part only far cartridge; rear has open-top relief S centre+-31, Z27.5..36. Latched bridge M2 blind vertical at N-20, S centre+-10, depth 4 from Z27.5; .5 shim + bridge 4 + M2x8 CSK flush 32. Root/axle/collar clearance across full hinge span.

name: pad_length
notes: Paper face: 90 degree countersink to received M2 head, flush 0..0.05 below surface. Hole Z=18 in assembly.

name: back_length
notes: Ream shaft bores 3.10+.03/-0. N-22..-18. Width plain part only far cartridge; rear has open-top relief S centre+-31, Z27.5..36. Latched bridge M2 blind vertical at N-20, S centre+-10, depth 4 from Z27.5; .5 shim + bridge 4 + M2x8 CSK flush 32. Root/axle/collar clearance across full hinge span.

name: cheek_front
notes: N=-18..-8.5. Along N at S4, Z7.5/32: dia3.2; hex nut pocket 5.60AF (corner dia6.47) from N-8.5 to -12.5; M3 nut 2.4 thick ends N-10.1. M3x20 tips N-10. Hardstop M2 along N at S4, Z18, flat button dia3 ends N-8.00; locknut rear. Fit separately each end; set delta 5 with gauge.

name: cheek_rear
notes: N=-30..-22; aligns backplate holes. Secondary drill along N, same Z/S as front. M3x20, no washer under rear head; recessed front nut behind N-10.1, screw tip N-10.0. Lock with low-strength removable threadlock.

name: latch_lever
notes: Origin N-27, Z34; pivot (8,2), crank (2,2). S-15..15. Central fork: mill through pocket N-28..-22, S-2..2 in root, no stock in pocket; drill crank dia2.2 only fork cheeks S+-2..4; pin dia2x9. Root retains two 2mm cheeks adjacent pocket. Pivot dia3.10. See HINGE.md.

name: post
notes: N-11..-3, Z36..62, S+-15. Mill underside relief: Z36..36.5, N-8.5..-3 through 30 span. Keep N-11..-8.5 rear attachment. M3 tapped along N at Z40, S+-10 for bridge screws. See HINGE.md.

name: latch_bridge
notes: Origin N-30, Z28; S-19.5..25.5. Foot Z28..32, upright Z32..44 ONLY S+-15; mill upright off outside 30 span. S19.5..25.5 spring wing top Z30. Pocket ear feet N-23..-15, S12..19.5 and -19.5..-12, Z30..32; retain 2mm base. Ear foot M2x4 at N-21/-17, S+-13.5. Spring bracket M2x6 from below at N-11, S20.5/24.5. Through pocket N-28..-22, S+-2 for rod/eye. Ears and S2 anchor attach per HINGE.md. Secondary M3 holes normal to N at Z40, S=+-10; countersink rear N=-15 flush for M3x10 into post. See D06. No protruding heads in lever gap.

name: connector_width
notes: Bottom Z=-13, bolts Z=-8/12. Floor slot centre at face normal -25, rail centre normal -20; use a 5 offset spacer. Transfer-drill mating block/cheek.

name: connector_length
notes: Bottom Z=-27, bolts Z=-22/7. Floor slot centre at face normal -25, rail centre normal -20; use a 5 offset spacer. Transfer-drill mating block/cheek.

name: carriage_block
notes: Local A running 0..20, B0..12, C0..12. Bore 6.10 along A at B6, C6. Connector dia3.2 along B at A5, C9. Do not machine a cross clamp here; two separate 14-high drag_block parts replace one near-width and one rear block. Width axis Z=-11, rear Z=-25. Other blocks loose-running.

name: shaft_support
notes: Section local B0..16, C0..16, extrude along shaft 12. Shaft bore dia6.00H7 along A at B8, C8. Split 1 B8, C11..16. Cross clamp M3 along B at A6, C13.5 (dia3.2 clear one half, M3 tap opposite). Mount bores M2 along A at B3, C3/10.5; supplied floor hang bracket per ASSEMBLY. Rear support bottom Z-33; width uses separate 4 long parts. Shaft axes V100/180, Z-11 and U+-60, Z-25.

name: pointer_flag
notes: Pointer plate N-24.7..-24.3 at zero, S10..18, Z15..36.8; pin hole S14, Z18; follows pin translation. Attach to lower end moving pin via offset arm; no scale stock intersection. Shelf S0..9.5, pointer gap 0.5. See SCALE.md.

name: stop_spacer
notes: Rear pin zero stop; front ring face at N=-22 with pin end N=-23. M2 washer/screw behind pin end. Select shims from actual zero setting.

name: plinth_side
notes: Plinth underside at table, floor underside 35 above it. Attach to end panels using corner angles; transfer-drill M3.

name: plinth_end
notes: Fits between 6-thick side panels, under 304-wide floor; V end cap thickness 6.

name: front_panel
notes: V=-12..0; no screw/feature proud of feed face V0. Outside dimensions retained.

name: side_wall
notes: U=+-146..152; V0..405. Machine to avoid back-wall double volume at corners.

name: back_wall
notes: V396..405 between side walls.

name: lock_rack_width
notes: Origin U-142. Tooth crests Z-16, root Z-16.25, bottom -19.25. Top blind M2 depth 2 at U-139, -59, V140; floor hung spacers 16.25 long. Holes lie outside pawl sweep. Rack phase .5 pitch, .25 crest width; no centering ramps.

name: lock_rack_length
notes: Origin V201. Tooth crests Z-29, root -29.25, bottom -32.25. Top blind M2 depth 2 at V205/386, U0. Floor hung spacers 29.25 long. Rack phase .5 pitch, .25 crest width. Bottom clearance 2.75 to table.

name: pawl
notes: S+-5, T+-2; matching teeth .15 wide, .20 deep. Body total height 4 including 1mm lid. Machine dia3.2 counterbore depth 2 from main body top D-1, bottom D-3, centered T0, S0 for rod pickup button. Top M1.6 blind holes depth 2 at T0, S+-3.5; lid fits flush. Guide bore 4.10x10.10. See PAWL.md; no nearest position snap outside +-0.05 phase window.

name: pinion_20t
notes: m1, 20deg, 20 teeth; pitch tooth thickness pi/2-.04, .04 nominal backlash per mesh. Cutter R<=.25 only below base circle. Free idler on FIXED dia6 axle; NO radial setscrew. Finished face 5.80+-.03; gap 6.00+-.05 between thrust washers. See AXLES.md.

name: coupling_rack
notes: m1 straight rack; pitchline local y0, teeth toward +y. Flip one rack for opposed coupling. Mount/phase with slotted brackets, trim endpoints clear of full stroke.

name: drag_block
notes: A0..20, B0..12, C0..14. Bore 6.10 along A at B6, C6. Slit 1 at B6 from C14 to bore; M3 cross screw along B at A14, C11.5 (clearance half 3.2, opposite M3 tap; washer + jam nut). Minimum bore/screw ligament .85, top wall .9. Connector at A5, C9 along B. Dry friction target only.

name: hinge_ear
notes: S/Z profile; positive S12..19.5, Z30..40, negative mirror. Extrude N-23..-15. Foot Z30..32 seats in bridge pocket. Pivot drill dia3.10 along S at N-19, Z36 through outer S16..19.5. Foot M2 CSK clear at N-21/-17, S+-13.5, screw M2x4 flush Z32 into 2mm remaining bridge. Two plain positive ears are NOT used: one per assembly positive; negative uses hinge_ear_stop.

name: hinge_ear_stop
notes: As plain ear but negative S-19.5..-12, Z30..44. Pivot dia3.10 at N-19, Z36. CNC slot in outer 3.5 S using hinge_stop_slot.dxf: center N-19, Z36, R6, width 2.00+0.02; theta 0..0.17. Lever press fit dia2h6 follower at N-19, Z42, S-20..-12. End caps form both mechanical stops; inspect actual angles.

name: s2_fixed_bracket
notes: Upright N-13..-9, Z30..44, S19.5..25.5, on relieved wing Z30. Bottom blind M2 depth 4 at N-11, S20.5/24.5, screws M2x6 from below wing 2. Spring leg blind bore dia1.30 along N from N-13 to -11 at Z40, S22.5. M2 set from Z44 at N-12, S22.5 tip Z40.6; clamps leg. Coil max N-14.4 gives 1.4 gap. S2 leg centerline uses mean radius 4, NOT outside 4.6.

name: s2_moving_anchor
notes: At zero N-24.6..-17, Z56..62, S14.5..24.5. Two M2 along S at N-19, Z57.5/60.5; M2x13 from S24.5 into 3.5mm tapped lever side. Leg bore dia1.30 vertical at N-23, S22.5, Z56..62. M2 setscrew from N-17 at Z59, S22.5 clamps leg at N-22.4. Leg is 26 straight up from tangent N-23, Z36. Main lever pinch surface unchanged; anchor is new exterior surface.

name: rod_eye
notes: Side profile center N-25 at zero; bottom Z30, eye hole Z36. Round upper corners R2. Bottom neck N+-1.5, Z30..34, axial M2 tap depth 3.8 from bottom. Eye S+-1 between fork S+-2; pin 2x9 with retained ends. Do not drill M2 into eye pin bore.

name: pawl_lid
notes: Recess M1.6 heads flush; body 3 high plus lid 1=4. Lid covers rod head counterbore; rod 2 passes center, integral button 3x1 below. Set 0.45 ±0.02 gap at zero. Lid base is top datum D-1; below gap head top D-1.4490005.

name: pawl_guide
notes: Plan T+-4.05, S+-8; bore T+-2.05, S+-5.05. Z=rack crest-1 to crest+8.25; relieve both T-walls to crest+0.30 over S+-5.05 so they clear the rack. Width Z-17..-7.75, rear -30..-20.75. Body slide 4.10x10.10. Two M1.6 cap mounts at T-2, S+-6.5. Floor hanger along T-3 with 2 M3 at S+-6.5. See PAWL.md.

name: pawl_cap
notes: Seat underside D+4.2; top D+6.2. S3 centered rod axis, flat S3 seat, no recess; spring gap 4.2. Pawl hardstop M2 at T-1, S3.5 adjustable tip D+1.2, locknut above; stop cannot contact spring. Cap fasten M1.6x5 to guide posts.

name: pawl_drop_width
notes: Moving hanger N-33.05..-29.05, S+-8, Z-17..-4. Top angle flange N-34..-24, S+-8, Z-4..-2; two M2 vertical at N-27, S+-6 to moving beam Z-2..0. Machine guide attachment two M2 along N at Z-15/-12, S+-6.5. Not fixed to floor. Guide bore center N-25.

name: pawl_drop_rear
notes: Same plan as width drop; vertical Z-30..-4. Top flange Z-4..-2. Guide attachment two M2 along N at Z-28/-25, S+-6.5. Moves with rear carriage beam. Guide bore center N-25.

name: pawl_beam_width
notes: Plan N-30..-20, S-46..46, Z-2..0. Main hole N-25, S0 clears rod. Blocks centres S+-40; mount M2x8 through 3 high risers into 3mm taps at block B1.5 (shaft B6), A5/8; .45 ligament to bore. Drop bracket M2 at N-27, S+-6, tapped beam 2 deep; screw M2x4. Gear faces end Z-3 -> 1 gap below beam.

name: pawl_beam_rear
notes: Plan N-30..-20, S-66..66, Z-2..0. Mount as width but 17 high risers and M2x22 through 17+2 into 3mm taps. Block axes S+-60, Z-25; top Z-19. Drop M2x4 at N-27, S+-6.

name: beam_riser_width
notes: Plan N-26.5..-20.5, S shaft-6..0; Z-5..-2 for plain blocks; drag block top Z-3 requires face height 1 instead of 3 at one width location. M2 screws fixed length trim to min 3 thread, max 3.5; no bores cross shaft. Each riser finished to actual top datum.

name: beam_riser_rear
notes: Plan as width at S shaft-6..0, Z-19..-2. Rear 14 high drag top Z-17 requires 15 high riser instead of 17 at one block. M2x22/20 respectively through 2+17/15 into 3 thread. All values design not measurements.

name: scale_shelf
notes: N-30..-24, S0..9.5, Z36..36.5. Adhesive art S4.5..9.5, Z36.5..36.6. Fix directly on cheek with M2x4 pan heads at N-29/-25, S2; head OD3.8, Z36.5..38.1. Brackets behind N-8.5; pointer S10..18 lateral clearance .5.

name: table_anchor
notes: L side profile U134..146, Z-35..-23 mirrored; extrude 12 along V at 6..18/384..396. Base M4 clear 4.5 vertical at U138, V12/390; two horizontal M3 along U at V9/15 or 387/393, Z-27, connect plinth side with countersunk M3 trim 9 flush outer U152. M4x8 into M4 bench thread 5 deep through base 3. Floor access dia8 U+-138, V12/390; flush covers removed during setup.

name: shaft_support_width
notes: Same 16x16 B/C section as rear shaft_support, but 4 along A. Bore 6.00H7 at B8, C8. Split 1 B8, C11..16; cross M3 along B at A2, C13.5; clear 3.2 half/tap other. Mount M2 along A at B3, C3/10.5. Install U141..145 and -145..-141; shafts U+-145. Wall U146..152 with 1 spacer: M2x10 CSK flush outer 152 into 3 support. Bodies at reset end U+-139 => 2mm gap.

name: width_support_spacer
notes: Between plinth side inner U+-146 and 4 long width support outer U+-145. Hole profile B/C; mated to support B3, C3/10.5. No external support bracket needed.

name: rail_hanger_rear
notes: Rear shaft end hanger; plane V200..203 or 399..402, U shaft+-10, Z-33..0. Top flange 20x8 under floor. Support center V209/393, 12 long. Shaft ends V203/399 length 196. Front support M2x8 along V through 3 hanger; rear support M2x10 CSK through 6 end wall; holes B3, C3/10.5. Carriage centres V226..376; 20 long bodies V216..386 leave 1 gap to 12 long supports V203..215/387..399. Shaft axis Z-25. See AXLES.md.

name: beam_riser_width_short
notes: Replaces 3 high riser at near 14 high drag block; Z-3..-2, M2x6.

name: beam_riser_rear_short
notes: Replaces 17 high riser at rear 14 high drag block; Z-17..-2, M2x20.

name: width_reset_washer
notes: Shaft travel stop shim; exact positions AXLES.md. Faces parallel .03; inspect travel endpoints.

name: rear_stop_washer
notes: Shaft travel stop shim; exact positions AXLES.md. Faces parallel .03; inspect travel endpoints.

name: width_stop_collar
notes: Split 1 along B0 from C3.05 to 7; cross M2 along B at A2, C5.5. Clamp .10Nm. Positions U-49..-45 and 45..49 on both width shafts. Flat face contacts block at 70mm.

name: rack_standoff_width
notes: Fixed floor to rack root. Locations U-139/-59, V140. M2 finished length 21 CSK flush floor top. Rack top blind M2 depth 2.

name: rack_standoff_rear
notes: U0, V205/386; finished M2x34 from floor top. Rack top blind M2 depth 2.

name: rack_mount_spacer
notes: Between moving beam underside Z-2 and rack top -3. M2x6 into 3mm rack. Near U-136/-132, V126.5; far U132/136, V153.5.

name: pinion_axle
notes: Lathe side profile, NOT extruded manufacture. Rotational axis N0; shoulder diam 10, Z-2.5..0, journal diam 6, Z-9.5..-2.5. Both ends M3 blind 4. AXLES.md. qty one fixed.

name: crank_rod_width
notes: Lathe one piece: button dia3x1 + shank dia2; button TOP to rod TIP 46.80, top 8 M2 thread. Length including button 47.80; actual gap set in eye. PAWL.md.

name: crank_rod_rear
notes: As width rod; button TOP to tip 59.80, total 60.80. Gap 0.45 ±0.02 adjusted and locked.

name: pad_stop_button
notes: Lathe part: flat head dia3x1 N-9..-8; M2 thread shank N-33..-9, rear adjustment slot. Front cheek M2 tap N-18..-9; head pocket dia3.2, N-9..-8.5. Backplate/rear cheek through clear 2.4 along N at S4/L-4, Z18. Rear washer .4 and M2 jam nut 1.6 N-32..-30; adjust from N-33. Extends 3 behind nominal housing; minimum wall gap 4 at reset.

name: back_width_latched
notes: Near only. Relief S19..81, Z27.5..36 through N-22..-18. M2 blind vertical at N-20, S40/60, depth 4 from 27.5. Bridge on .5 shims, M2x8 CSK from 32 tip 24. Relief +-31 clears hinge collars up to 28.5 and axle 30. Ream pin bores 3.10+.03/-0.

name: bridge_shim
notes: N-22..-18, S=latch centre+-10 (span 6), Z27.5..28. Supports bridge foot on relieved backplate. One M2x8 CSK per shim into 3.5 thread. Two per latched cartridge.

name: handle
notes: U+-50, V-22..-12, Z40..50. M3x14 from V-22 counterbored 5.5x3 into front panel blind M3 depth 8, axes U+-35, Z45. Heads flush V-22. Handle is fixed exterior geometry; included overall V-22..405.
